actions.test_case: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total
actions.message: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total の assertion error が 14回連続。最優先で対処。

details.estimated_root_cause: Coupon UI shows success/10% OFF but total stays ¥418 instead of discounted ¥380; discount is not applied to order total calculation/rendering.
details.recommended_action: Fix coupon discount computation or total recomputation after apply; verify rounding and displayed total update.
